description: Header file defining interfaces for mustach-jansson integration, including functions for rendering mustache templates with JSON data to files, file descriptors, memory buffers, and custom callbacks.

methods.name: mustach_jansson_file
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string to a specified file using JSON data.

methods.name: mustach_jansson_fd
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string to a file descriptor using JSON data.

methods.name: mustach_jansson_mem
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string into a memory buffer using JSON data.

methods.name: mustach_jansson_write
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string to a custom writer callback with JSON data.

methods.name: mustach_jansson_emit
methods.description: Renders a mustache template string to a custom emitter callback with JSON data.

methods.name: mustach_jansson_apply
methods.description: Applies a mustache template to JSON data with optional write and emit callbacks.
